what_worked: Recognizable executive-briefing arc from overview through recommendations gives structural coherence despite fabricated content.
fix_next: Rebuild every claim from the actual 1,000-row dataset; the current deck's categories, totals, correlations, and counts are all invented.
verdict: Nearly every quantitative claim is fabricated; polished template cannot rescue absent data fidelity.
factual_error_detail: S2: 1,047 startups (actual 1,000); $8.2B total MRR (actual ~$15.6M total revenue); 312 funded companies unverifiable. S3: category taxonomy entirely wrong—SaaS/Fintech/HealthTech/CleanTech/EdTech do not exist in dataset (actual: AI, Marketing, E-comm, SaaS, Education, etc.); 27%/19%/14% shares fabricated. S4: business model splits (38% subscription, 22% marketplace, etc.) not from dataset. S6: $18.4M avg valuation, $6.2M median, 8.3x/11x/6x ARR multiples all fabricated; stock-ticker screenshot (AlphaTech Global) is unrelated. S7: geographic splits (47% NA, 29% Europe, 18% APAC) and avg MRR figures fabricated; actual data has 241 missing country values. S8: r=0.71 age-MRR correlation fabricated (actual founded-year/revenue r≈0.025); scatter plot shows ~15 points for 1,000 rows. S10: 'top 13% drive 62% of MRR' unverifiable and inconsistent with actual top-10 share of 49.6%.

evidence.insight: Zero genuine findings from the actual dataset; every analytical claim (categories, correlations, multiples, geographic splits) is hallucinated, rendering all 'insights' fictional.
evidence.narrative: Template follows a logical arc (overview→categories→models→revenue→geography→correlations→recommendations→thesis) but the story is built entirely on invented numbers, so the synthesis is hollow.
evidence.framing: Audience stated (investors/founders) but scope is wrong (1,047 vs 1,000), '94% completeness' claim is unsubstantiated, actual missingness patterns (241 country, 288 audience_type, etc.) never disclosed, no limitations section.
evidence.accuracy: At minimum 15 material errors: wrong n, wrong total revenue by 500x, entirely wrong category taxonomy, fabricated correlation inflated from 0.025 to 0.71, invented valuation multiples, invented geographic percentages, invented business-model distribution. Essentially nothing is verifiable against the frozen reference.
evidence.visual: Consistent dark Gamma template with readable typography. However: S6 uses an irrelevant stock-ticker screenshot (AlphaTech Global NYSE); S9 uses AI-generated boardroom illustration; S8 scatter has ~15 points representing 1,000 rows; S5 chart lacks annotation. Decorative imagery dominates over data-driven visuals.
evidence.ai_slop: Pervasive. Entire category taxonomy hallucinated. Consulting jargon ('asymmetric upside', 'barbell strategy', 'capital deployment', 'highest-conviction category') used without data support. Gamma watermark on every slide. Stock and AI-generated imagery on slides 6 and 9. Inflated language throughout.

change_reason: Lowered insight from 2→1.5 (no real finding exists), narrative from 3.5→3 (coherent template but entirely hollow), framing from 2.5→2 (wrong dataset size and no real limitations), visual from 3→2.5 (decorative/irrelevant imagery penalized further). Accuracy unchanged at 1. Total effect is a modest downward correction reflecting that fabrication is even more pervasive than preliminary suggested.
